Sarah's password security practices have significant weaknesses. Using the same password for every account is highly risky because if one account is compromised, all other accounts using that same password are also vulnerable. Although she changes the password monthly, this does not mitigate the risk of a single breach affecting multiple services. Additionally, relying on a single password for all accounts increases the likelihood of it being guessed or cracked, especially if it is not sufficiently complex.

A group of crows is called a murder.
